question: Which of the following Schedules of the Constitution of India have immunity from Judicial Review?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**9th Schedule**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **9th Schedule** of the Constitution of India was introduced by the First Amendment in **1951**.
 
• It contains certain laws that are beyond the scope of **judicial review**. These laws were initially aimed at protecting land reform and agrarian laws from being challenged in courts.
